sre-oncall: paste sample logs?
leo: logs:
```
embed_worker: latency_ms=2800 samples=120 errors=4 code=502
runtime: allocate_buffer failed; free_gpu_mem=120MB required=256MB
```
sanika: could be memory fragmentation after model change. before we roll back, can we try ephemeral shard spin-up + targeted prefill on canary to validate?
sam: ok spin up 1 ephemeral shard for canary and run prefill. tag it canary-ephem-1. do not increase global traffic percentage
deploybot: ephemeral shard created: canary-ephem-1. running prefill task id=pref-821 for route=/embed parallel=6

`curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -d '{"input":"warmup"}' https://eu1.api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings | jq '.latency'`
leo: result: p95=720ms, errors=0/100
sre-oncall: that's promising. canary traffic steady. suggest hold at 4% for 30m and monitor memory-alloc-failures metric. rollback only if error rate >1% sustained for 5m
sanika: filing a short release note entry with steps run and prefills used. will also open issue to investigate allocator behavior on new model variant
sam: agreed. leaving debug trace on canary-ephem-1 for next 15m. thanks team. :thumbsup:
